notes: Single-author primary research article, Int J Hydrogen Energy 45 (2020) 23966-23970; no SI supplied. not_primary, retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in PDF) and duplicate_data do not apply: the paper cites the author's earlier conference paper on SWNT/Pt synthesis [26] but does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before. Method inconsistency: Experimental says Sieverts-type PCT-Pro-2000 (volumetric), Conclusion says 'by a gravimetric measurement method'; either satisfies I1. Figure y-axes are labelled 'Absolute H2 uptake (wt%)'. Samples: as-purchased SWNT (US Research Nanomaterials, purity >95%) and Pt-loaded SWNT, at 77 K and RT (300 K) up to about 25 bar. Exclusion rests solely on I4: no surface area value of any kind is reported.
